title: Applied Composites
description:
Applied Composites is a leading U.S. manufacturer specializing in advanced composite components, assemblies, engineering, and tooling for the aerospace, defense, and space industries. The company provides highly engineered composite structures for aircraft, engines, missiles, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), satellites, and launch vehicles. Its vertically integrated capabilities include design, tooling, manufacturing, machining, assembly, testing, and engineering support. Applied Composites operates multiple specialized facilities equipped with autoclaves, CNC machining centers, clean rooms, and advanced testing equipment. The company serves major aerospace and defense organizations and focuses on delivering lightweight, durable, high-performance composite solutions for demanding commercial, military, and space applications. 
The company headquarters is located in 25671 Commercentre Drive, Lake Forest, CA 92630, United States. 501-1000 Employees
